title: Nithoniel Nayak vs Mimansa Sinha on 15 July, 2026

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF ORISSA AT CUTTACK

 TRP(C) No.382 of 2025

 Nithoniel Nayak .... Petitioner

 Mr. Ramdas Achary, Advocate
 -versus-
 Mimansa Sinha .... Opp. Party


 CORAM:
 JUSTICE MRUGANKA SEKHAR SAHOO

 ORDER

05. 1. The Office has pointed out typographical error in
 order dated 15.05.2026, wherein the number of the case
 has been wrongly typed as '382 of 2026' instead of '382
 of 2025'.

The wrong entry i.e. numerical '6' shall be corrected
 as '5' in the body of the order as per Rules.

2. The petitioner before this Court is the husband in
 the marriage. He seeks transfer of C.P. No.763 of 2024
 pending before the learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack
 to the Court of learned Judge, Family Court, Phulbani.

Signed by: RAJESH KUMAR BADHEI
Reason: Authentication
 marriage under section 10 of the Divorce Act, 1869
Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA,
CUTTACK
Date: 22-Jul-2026 18:49:37 seeking decree of divorce and dissolution of marriage
 solemnized between the parties on 30.09.2014.

3. It is submitted that both the parties to the litigation
 stay at Phulbani and there would be no difficulty for the
 Page 1 of 2
 present Opp. Party, who is the petitioner in the C.P. to
 attend the matter at Phulbani, which is around 235 kms.
 from Cuttack.
4. Issue notice to the Opp. Party along with this order.

Requisites for issuance of notice by Speed Post with
 Registration and proof of delivery shall be filed within five
 working days.

The matter shall be listed 'For Orders' in the week
 commencing 24.08.2026.
6. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
He reiterates his submissions as noted above.

Accept one set of process fee as well as postal
 requisites.

The returnable date as well as next the date of
 listing shall be as directed above.

8. In the interim, it is directed that the C.P. No.763 of
 2024 pending before the learned Judge, Family Court,
 Cuttack shall be adjourned to a date beyond 31.08.2026
 as would be convenient to the learned Court in seisin of
 the matter upon a prayer being made for the said
